items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:02 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Councillor P. Singh - Potential Land Acquisition (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)) - Item 6.3 on the agenda
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a conflict with Item 6.3 Potential Land Acquisition (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)), listed on the in-camera agenda this date, as he owns property in the vicinity of the subject property, he did not participate in any voting or discussion related to the item.

items.title: Municipal Land Acquisition Strategy - Sanitary and Stormwater Utility (Land Acquisition Section 239 (2) (c))
notes: J. Readman, General Manager, Development Services Department, responded to questions related to the timeline on this matter, noting the full expropriation process will take approximately 18 to 24 months, noting all property owners subject to the approval this date, have already been notified of the City's intentions.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes:
The Special Council meeting then recessed at 4:06 p.m. and reconvened at 5:37 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present.

Councillor P. Singh clarified that he had declared a conflict prior to the in-camera meeting and confirmed his conflict was with the Potential Land Acquisition (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)), noted as item 6.3 on the agenda this date.

items.title: To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for June 3, 2024.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 5:39 p.m.
